preconditions.description: The number of additions is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= i for i, pi in enumerate(pis, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each parent index pi is between 1 and the current vertex index i.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 1 for cost in output)
postconditions.description: Each cost in the output is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(cost <= i + 1 for i, cost in enumerate(output, start=1))
postconditions.description: The cost after adding i vertices is at most i + 1.
